name: Azure Quick Review: read-only Azure assessment
purpose: Read Azure resource inventory, resiliency recommendations, Advisor findings, Defender plan status, and diagnostics configuration for one subscription and an optional resource group. Display structured findings and generate a report for human and LLM review; no remediation is performed.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.label: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
parameters.help: Find the tenant ID in Microsoft Entra ID > Overview in the Azure portal. Example format: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.label: Azure subscription ID
parameters.help: Find the subscription ID in Azure portal > Subscriptions. The application needs Reader access to this subscription.

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.label: Resource group
parameters.help: Leave blank for the subscription, or enter one resource-group name to narrow the read-only scan.

parameters.name: AzqrPath
parameters.label: AZQR executable file
parameters.help: Use the installed azqr.exe file, or choose Browse. The launcher verifies its checksum before running it.

outcomes: A readable summary and findings in the Report and Record table tabs.
Local report.md and report.json files, including instructions for an LLM.
A clearly marked incomplete result if collection is interrupted or cannot retrieve some data.
notes: This report collects data. It does not make changes to Azure resources.
Azure is the cloud resource platform. This report does not assess Microsoft 365 mail or Exchange settings.
The launcher uses Windows file paths with backslashes. Web links use forward slashes.
prerequisites: Your Microsoft Entra tenant ID and Azure subscription ID. Both are GUIDs; find them in the Azure portal.
An existing application with Azure Reader access. Save its application ID and client secret using Session credentials.
The verified AZQR executable is already installed locally. The Executable file field should point to C:\iso-psrepo\tools\azqr.exe.
steps: Open Session credentials. Choose Azure application, then enter the application ID and client secret.
Open Parameters. Enter your tenant ID and subscription ID. Leave Resource group empty to review the whole subscription.
Keep the executable path shown, or click Browse to select the verified azqr.exe file.
Choose Run report. A scan can take several minutes.
guide.overview: Review Azure resources for reliability and security configuration concerns. The scan reads one subscription and can be limited to one resource group.
